recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical composition featuring a photographic upper section with two female subjects in profile facing each other against a soft-focus garden background, and a clean white lower section containing large-scale serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Eye contact and hand gesture creating a diagonal tension between subjects
Contrast between the busy, warm-toned photo and the stark white typographic base
Color coordination between the subject's clothing and the primary title color
Symmetrical framing of the two subjects within the upper two-thirds of the frame
coreInvariants: Horizontal division between image and text block
Soft-focus green and red bokeh background
High-contrast red serif lettering on white

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects in profile, waist-up, occupying the left and right thirds of the upper image area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central pointing finger gesture and the large red title text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top metadata text, moves down to the subjects' faces, follows the pointing gesture, and lands on the primary title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of white space in the bottom third to provide legibility and breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest greens and earthy browns in the photographic section.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white used for the lower text block and top metadata.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red used for the main title and highlights in the subject's sweater.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subjects' clothing and title text against a muted, dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to naturalistic skin tones and garden hues

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a cohesive block of color
Uniform stroke width for the secondary metadata text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast display serif for the title paired with a lighter, more spaced-out serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like separation between image and text

avoid: Centered text that overlaps the subjects' faces

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant vertical stress.
A modern alternative with similar weight and serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic medium shot of two women (one older with glasses, one younger with long wavy hair) facing each other in profile. The older woman points a finger playfully at the younger woman. The background is a lush, out-of-focus garden at dusk with bokeh lights. Leave the bottom 30% of the frame as solid white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center a two-line title in the white area using a bold red Didone serif font. Add a single line of white metadata text at the very top of the image in a light serif font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the title text centered in the white footer?
Does the red of the text match the red accents in the image?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to make the subjects pop?
Are both subjects in profile facing inward?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the title
Amount of white space in the footer
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original actors
Original studio logos or billing blocks

avoid: Low-contrast text on the white footer

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the white background
Ensure the pointing gesture is clearly visible
Verify the horizontal split is straight and clean
Confirm the color harmony between the red text and the image elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Photographic Profile Duo + Bokeh Garden + White Footer + Red High-Contrast Serif Typography
